subject.title: [Bug]: Web UI chat images display too large

question: Should maintainers adopt, replace, or reject the open fork PR that applies sidebar markdown image sizing parity for this issue?
rationale: Current main still has the source-visible CSS mismatch, but the narrow fix candidate is not merged into openclaw/openclaw and needs maintainer-controlled landing or rejection.

options.title: Adopt or replace the CSS parity fix
options.body: Create or land a maintainer-controlled version of the sidebar image sizing change with browser proof for markdown images in the sidebar.

options.title: Wait for the fork author
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the fork PR author for fresh proof and an upstream landing path.

options.title: Reject this fix shape
options.body: Keep this issue open only if maintainers decide the oversized-image symptom needs a different proven root-cause fix.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the CSS parity fix
recommendation.body: Create or land a maintainer-controlled version of the sidebar image sizing change with browser proof for markdown images in the sidebar.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the clearest history connection to the UI styling change that introduced the mismatched image caps.
